# Ritesh Patil — AI/ML Engineer & Generative AI Developer

> Official portfolio of Ritesh Patil, an AI/ML Engineer and Generative AI Developer based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Who is Ritesh Patil?

Ritesh Patil is an AI/ML Engineer and Generative AI Developer from Pune, India, currently working as an AI Engineer at Abhiyanta India Solutions. He has 3+ years of hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems — including RAG pipelines, Agentic AI workflows, Computer Vision solutions, and Cloud-Native AI deployments. He bridges the gap between AI research and real-world enterprise applications.

## Core Expertise

- **Generative AI & RAG Systems**: LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, OpenAI GPT-4, FAISS, Pinecone, Prompt Engineering, RAG pipeline architecture
- **Agentic AI**: Multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling agents, autonomous AI workflows, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate
- **Computer Vision & ML**: YOLO (v8/v11), TensorFlow, OpenCV, Roboflow, TensorFlow Lite, medical imaging
- **Cloud & MLOps**: AWS EC2, AWS SageMaker, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, SAP AI Core, SAP BTP
- **Enterprise AI Integration**: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Dataverse, M365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint)
- **Languages & Frameworks**: Python, FastAPI, Angular, Node.js, Express.js

## Notable Projects

### 1. Medical Chatbot — RAG + LangChain + AWS + Docker
End-to-end Medical Chatbot using a RAG pipeline. Built with LangChain, OpenAI GPT-4, Pinecone, and FAISS for vector retrieval. Deployed using Docker containers on AWS EC2 with CI/CD pipelines. Enables natural language Q&A over large medical knowledge bases with accurate, cited responses.

### 2. Retina Heart Disease Detection — Computer Vision & Medical Imaging
Computer Vision system for automated medical image analysis. Uses YOLO and TensorFlow to detect retinal and cardiac disease markers from scan images. Built with OpenCV and Roboflow for data processing and annotation.

### 3. CEO Agentic Chatbot — Enterprise Agentic AI
Enterprise-grade Agentic AI assistant built for executive decision support. Developed on Microsoft Copilot Studio with Power Automate orchestration, integrating with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Dataverse. Automates complex cross-departmental AI workflows.

### 4. Virtual Kiosk — EdTech Offline Learning Platform
Offline-first educational platform serving rural and low-connectivity areas. Built with Angular, Node.js, and Express.js with smart JSON routing. Supports both online and offline content delivery without internet dependency.

### 5. Industrial Object Detection — Edge Computer Vision Deployment
Real-time industrial quality control system using YOLO for object detection. Deployed on Android devices via TensorFlow Lite (edge inference) and managed via AWS SageMaker. Operates fully offline in factory environments.
